title: Hilbert-90 quotient maps, torsion defects, and symmetric monodromy
summary: Let $τ(z)=-1-z^{-1}$. We study the reduced rational maps $h_d:\mathbb{P}^1\to\mathbb{P}^1$ obtained by cancelling common factors in $H_d^{\rm raw}(z)=z^d(τ(z)^d-1)/(z^d-1)$. These maps arise by Hilbert-90 descent from the trace-zero maps $X^{dq}-X^d$ on $\ker\operatorname{Tr}_{\mathbb{F}_{q^3}/\mathbb{F}_q}$, but the principal object is the resulting $τ$-equivariant quotient-map family; nonconstant separable members are viewed as covers.
